channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Rights are just ‘words on a page’ if federal agents can ignore them
item.description: Individual rights are being erased and basic freedoms sacrificed on the altar of “mass deportations.”

item.title: Orange Lutheran boys soccer beats Valencia, advances to Open Division final
item.description: Orange Lutheran wins the series with Valencia and earns a showdown with Trinity League rival Mater Dei in the championship game.

item.title: Donovan Dent’s OT layup lifts UCLA men to upset of No. 10 Illinois
item.description: Dent scores with one second left in overtime in the 95-94 win. Eric Dailey Jr. leads the Bruins with 20 points, and Tyler Bilodeau adds 18 as UCLA erases a 23-point, first-half deficit.

item.title: LAFC trounces Inter Miami, Messi in season opener
item.description: David Martinez, Denis Bouanga and Nathan Ordaz score in a 3-0 shutout. A crowd of 75,673 at the Memorial Coliseum watches LAFC open the season with a statement win over the MLS champions.

item.title: UC Irvine men erase big deficit but fall to UC San Diego
item.description: The Anteaters dig their way out of a 17-point hole and take a lead on Jurian Dixon’s 3-pointer with 2:05 left, but the Tritons regroup and hand them a 71-69 home loss that creates a three-way tie atop the standings.

item.title: El Dorado girls basketball stops Marina with tough defense in semifinals
item.description: El Dorado's lead is cut to six going into the fourth quarter, but Delaney Shiring helps the team pull away at the end and secure a spot in the Division 4 title game.

item.title: Santa Margarita girls soccer rallies to tie Oaks Christian, earns spot in finals
item.description: Felicity Nguyen scores the equalizer in the 54th minute as Santa Margarita reaches the Open Division championship game with a roster filled with underclassmen.

item.title: Girls basketball playoffs: Sage Hill advances; 5 OC teams reach CIF-SS finals
item.description: OCVarsity's roundup has the highlights from the CIF-SS girls basketball playoff games Saturday, Feb. 21.

item.title: Anti-AI Luddites are on the rise in California
item.description: Free-market capitalism and technological progress have allowed even the poorer members of society to obtain goods once considered luxuries and substantially improved the standard of living.

item.title: La Cañada girls basketball pushes past Canyon to reach D4 title game
item.description: Canyon leads briefly in the third quarter until La Cañada goes on a 10-0 run to take control and move on to the championship round.
